baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled H-J-J at words 2 and 10 is followed by D-H-D at word 11 and the Lord-attribution at words 12-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root names both the act of contesting and its proof-object; that object is then denied stability in the Lord's evaluative presence. Wrath and punishment follow failed standing rather than functioning as extra premises in the dispute.

activation_trace.role: The prevailing-proof branch supplies the forensic instrument that the disputants claim and that the clause tests.
The invalidated-proof branch gives the explicit adverse verdict on that instrument.
Nearness and presence turn the verdict into status before the Lord rather than a merely human loss of debate.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the authority before whom argumentative standing is decided.

changed_reading.before: The opponents simply have a weak argument.
changed_reading.after: Their claim is a forensic instrument brought into the Lord's jurisdiction and formally deprived of standing there.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The H-J-J proof-object at words 2/10 is predicated by the D-H-D image at word 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: A proof can function as a directed, evident road, while D-H-D supplies ground on which a foot cannot remain fixed. The clause therefore renders argumentative failure as loss of traction: the proposed route cannot carry its claimant into stable presence before the Lord.

activation_trace.role: The intended clear-road branch gives the argument a directional and traversable claim.
Slippery footing removes the traction needed to occupy or complete that claimed route.
Presence before the Lord is the destination at which the route fails to support them.

changed_reading.after: Their supposed clear route loses its footing and cannot sustain a position before the Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal construction at word 6 places the response at word 8 before the renewed H-J-J contest.
baseline_models.mechanism: The response is not background decoration but a procedural threshold. Disputation occurs only after an answer or response has already taken effect, so its belatedness helps explain why the ensuing proof is dislodged.

activation_trace.role: Temporal succession establishes a completed response before the disputation's renewed claim.
Answering and response provide the event after which the argument becomes procedurally late.
The proof branch marks the attempted reopening of a matter that has already received response.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns disagreement in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: It condemns a proof-claim advanced after response has crossed a decisive temporal threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, a call is issued, response is associated with believers and divine increase, believers respond to their Lord in communal practice, and an imperative demands response before an irreversible day. The focus passive now sits inside a reciprocal call-response circuit; continued disputation tries to reopen a relation already enacted.

activation_trace.role: The focus response is the grammatical hinge whose participants are clarified, though not fully disambiguated, by recurrence.
The verbal call supplies the initiating side of the communicative circuit immediately before the focus.
A second response occurrence couples answering with believers, good action, increase, and favor.
Punitive pain repeats the focus consequence on the contrasting side of the response scene.
Intensified force completes the exact consequence-pair also attached to the focus disputants.
Believers' answering becomes an enacted posture rather than a merely verbal assent.
Lordship identifies the addressee of the believers' response and links it to the focus tribunal.
The imperative form converts response into the urgent alternative to later disputation.
The Lord is again the explicit endpoint of response, closing the circuit opened by the call.

structural_cues: 42:15 issues a call and then removes argument between the two parties.
42:26 repeats both the response root and the focus's severe-punishment pair in a believer/unbeliever contrast.
42:38 embeds response in prayer, consultation, and giving; 42:47 turns it into an urgent imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated response forms with divine, believer, and imperative configurations; I infer a reciprocal relation already actualized before the focus dispute. A live alternative is that the focus passive refers more narrowly to a response granted for God or His cause, and 42:26 also leaves its grammatical participant structure somewhat open.

changed_reading.before: The focus follows an unspecified answer whose relation to the disputants is unclear.
changed_reading.after: The focus interrupts a surah-wide call-response circuit: after response to the Lord has become enacted, argument is a belated attempt to undo that responsive relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence supplies impartial judgment, truth, balance, separating decision, decisive judgment, and the removal of falsehood. These cues convert the focus's failed proof from a debate result into an adjudicated status under a governing standard.

activation_trace.role: The proof branch supplies the claim submitted for evaluation.
The failed-proof branch supplies the adverse disposition of the claim.
Justice in judgment supplies the interpersonal standard immediately preceding the focus.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the reality-standard against which the proof is tested.
The balance of justice turns evaluation into measured rather than partisan comparison.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the decisive boundary between claims.
The cutting judgment branch supplies the act that would settle the parties' case.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the object removed by the divine verdict.
The establishment and manifestation of truth supplies the positive counterpart to the focus proof's collapse.

structural_cues: 42:15-17 moves from no argument between the parties to the focus verdict and then immediately to truth and balance.
42:21 delays a separating judgment while preserving its authority.
42:24 pairs removal of falsehood with establishment of truth through divine words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dense legal-measure sequence; I infer that 'at their Lord' marks jurisdiction and that D-H-D functions as a ruling on standing. The live alternative is a less institutional reading in which these are simply convergent evaluative metaphors.

changed_reading.before: The disputants lose an exchange of reasons.
changed_reading.after: Their claim is measured under truth and balance, denied standing in divine jurisdiction, and placed on the falsehood side of a separating judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's clear-road and slippery-footing branches expand into a whole-surah itinerary: stand straight, do not stray far, find no deviation or escape, face no return or refuge, and be guided to a straight path. The proof fails because it cannot support a viable route through the surah's moral space.

activation_trace.role: The clear intended road gives the proof a route-like claim.
Slippery footing makes that route physically unable to hold its claimant.
Straightness and equilibrium supply the commanded posture against which slipping is measured.
Straying from guidance identifies continued disputation as directional loss.
Deviation from a direction supplies the escape movement denied to those who dispute the signs.
Return to a prior position is explicitly unavailable once the response deadline passes.
Refuge supplies the destination that the failed route cannot reach.
The straight path provides the surah's positive traversable route.
Straightness closes the path sequence by restoring the stable alignment absent from the disputants' proof.

structural_cues: The focus is framed by a command to stand straight at 42:15 and distant straying at 42:18.
The later dispute at 42:35 ends with no directional escape.
42:47 removes return and refuge, while 42:52-53 closes the surah on the straight path to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated posture, route, straying, return, and refuge cues; I infer that the focus's material slipping is a spatial mechanism for argumentative failure. A live alternative is that the path network is a rhetorical echo rather than an activated sense of the proof noun.

changed_reading.before: The proof is merely refuted at one moment.
changed_reading.after: The proof offers a route that cannot hold a step, veers into distant straying, and yields neither escape nor return, in contrast to the straight path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places wrath and punishment upon the disputants under the Lord's verdict, while the later community sequence turns human anger toward forgiveness, pardon, repair, and patience. The sanction is therefore vertically assigned to divine judgment rather than horizontally delegated as communal retaliation.

activation_trace.role: Intensified wrath oriented to requital supplies the sanction placed upon the disputants.
Sovereign lordship locates authority for the adverse verdict and its sanction.
The same anger branch is activated in believers but immediately redirected by the verse's next action.
Covering the fault and protecting from its effect supplies the believer's response to anger.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense limits the human impulse to mirror the focus sanction.
Removing estrangement turns pardon into active repair rather than passive surrender.
Restraint of the self supplies the durable posture that contains retaliatory anger.

structural_cues: 42:37 places forgiveness directly after believers become angry.
42:39-42 allows redress yet praises pardon and repair, distinguishing justice from retaliation.
42:43 joins patience and forgiveness as a resolved course of action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine wrath in the focus and disciplined human anger later; I infer a jurisdictional division in which the focus is descriptive of divine liability, not a command to imitate wrath. The live alternative is that the passages regulate different situations and do not fully define one another; the self-defense allowance remains intact.

changed_reading.before: The focus can sound like a mandate for the responding community to treat disputants with wrath.
changed_reading.after: Wrath and punishment remain liabilities under divine judgment, while human respondents are directed toward restraint, pardon, and repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later context depicts partners initiating a religious arrangement without divine permission and an accusation that revelation was fabricated, followed by removal of falsehood. This sharpens disputation 'concerning God' into rival authorization and false norm-claim, not every sincere question or unresolved inquiry.

activation_trace.role: The proof branch supplies the authority-claim advanced through disputation.
Worship and the worshipped object anchor the dispute in divine allegiance and authority.
Obedience and submission provide the normative domain affected by the rival claim.
Entering and initiating an affair gives the rival claim enacted scope rather than leaving it as speech alone.
Permission supplies the authorization explicitly absent from the rival religious arrangement.
Fabricating a lie supplies the specific accusation through which rival authority is asserted.
Opposition to truth classifies the asserted revelation-claim as false testimony.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the fate of the unauthorized claim.

structural_cues: 42:21 combines partners, religious ordering, absent permission, and delayed judgment.
42:24 names a fabrication accusation and then opposes falsehood to established truth.
The focus occurs after 42:15 has already separated deeds, removed mutual argument, and assigned gathering to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unauthorized religious enactment and fabricated revelation claims; I infer that the focus dispute concerns rival authority after response. A live alternative is the narrower reading that only the accusation against revelation, rather than all norm-making, is in view.

changed_reading.before: Any theological questioning after a response appears to be condemned.
changed_reading.after: The condemned argument is more specifically a belated rival authority-claim that reopens divine authorization and advances false religious standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses material J-W-B and D-H-D branches together with the later rain scene rather than the dominant answer and invalid-proof senses. It remains anchored to focus words 8 and 11 and to the repeated temporal sequence at 42:28. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The response at word 8 is immediately followed by the proof's loss of footing at word 11.

activation_trace.role: A penetrating cut recasts response as a breakthrough through a closed condition.
An opening or cleared interval supplies the changed terrain produced by that breakthrough.
Water-linked slipperiness makes the old proof unable to retain traction after the opening.
Rain descending from above supplies a concrete event that transforms exhausted ground.
The same after-before relation repeats the focus's threshold structure in the rain scene.
Opening, spreading, and branching extend the transformed-terrain image into distributed mercy.

changed_reading.before: Response is only a verbal event followed by an unrelated failed argument.
changed_reading.after: Response is exploratorily pictured as a breakthrough that changes the ground, so the old proof loses traction on the very terrain the response has opened.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it activates the packet's non-dominant J-B-Y mapping for the focus response. It remains valid as a trace because the split mapping is explicit and the surah immediately supplies gathering and consultation. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social echo of response, not claim that collection is the lexical sense required by the focus form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The response at word 8 precedes the renewed H-J-J proof-claim at words 2/10.

activation_trace.role: The split-root collection branch allows response to echo as something socially gathered and consolidated.
The proof branch supplies the later claim that attempts to contest the consolidated response.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies a nearby social consolidation under divine agency.
Extracting judgment through mutual review gives the responding community an enacted deliberative form.
A connection maintained between parties supplies the relational structure in which consultation operates.

changed_reading.before: Response is an isolated assent made by an unspecified participant.
changed_reading.after: Response can faintly echo as an aggregation around the call, making later argument an attempt to fracture a gathered and consultative order.

strongest_changes: The passive response became part of a reciprocal surah-wide circuit linking call, divine favor, believers' enacted response, and an urgent imperative.
The failed proof became both an adjudicated claim under truth and balance and a route that cannot retain traction or find escape.
Wrath was allocated to divine judgment while the responding community's own anger was disciplined toward pardon and repair.
The dispute narrowed from generic questioning to a belated rival authorization or false religious claim.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence joined communicative, legal, spatial, and social mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation. The split J-W-B inventory also preserved material-breakthrough and social-aggregation echoes as contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The agent and beneficiary of the passive response clause remain syntactically open, and the related construction at 42:26 does not remove every ambiguity.
The tribunal and route models may be complementary metaphors rather than separable senses.
The material-terrain and social-aggregation outliers depend on non-dominant branches and should not govern translation.
